strings.name: Gianluigi Aponte
strings.summary: From a maritime family near the Bay of Naples, Aponte worked as a captain and banker before founding MSC with his wife Rafaela in 1970. The business expanded from one cargo vessel into global container shipping, ports, ferries and cruises. Ownership passed to his children in late 2025 while he remained group chairman; the family handover was announced in April 2026.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; reviewed on 15 November. This is not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Founded Mediterranean Shipping Company and expanded from shipping operations into global container transport, ports and cruise services.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f1.value: Sorrento area, Italy; some accounts specify Sant’Agnello.
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Maritime training in Italy leading to qualification as a ship’s captain.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Global shipping
strings.highlights.h1.text: Co-founded MSC with Rafaela, developing a single-vessel operation into a global container network.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Diversification
strings.highlights.h2.text: The group expanded into ports, ferries and cruises, creating an integrated maritime-services business.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Transferred MSC ownership
strings.timeline.t1.text: Transferred MSC ownership to children Diego and Alexa in the fourth quarter; announced in April 2026.
strings.timeline.t2.title: MSC fleet capacity ranked first
strings.timeline.t2.text: MSC overtook Maersk in container-fleet capacity, becoming the largest liner by that measure.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Handed over MSC executive management
strings.timeline.t3.text: Son Diego became MSC chief executive while he remained group chairman.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Group invested in GNV
strings.timeline.t4.text: The group acquired a stake in ferry operator GNV, expanding Mediterranean ferry operations.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Acquired SNAV
strings.timeline.t6.title: Acquired StarLauro cruise business
strings.timeline.t6.text: Acquired cruise business StarLauro, which later developed into MSC Cruises.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Co-founded MSC
strings.timeline.t7.text: Co-founded MSC with Rafaela, operating one cargo ship between Europe and Africa.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Born near Sorrento
strings.timeline.t8.text: Born in the Sorrento area of Italy; later trained for maritime service and worked on ferries.
